observed_failure.cause: The frozen observer assumed an object while eight consumers emitted a string.

correction: Require receipt.owner to be an object with exact entry and operation in every neutral task packet.
Make the observer classify every non-object owner as authority_ambiguity instead of crashing.
Add a planted string-owner control before launching replacement consumers.
decision: The first 18 receipts are retained as invalid-trial evidence and are not reused for a treatment claim. Launch a fresh matched 18-run comparison only after this correction and its controls are frozen.
